اقتوين (form VIII)
# اِقْتَوَيْنَ (iqtawayna) /iq.ta.waj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# اُقْتُوِينَ (uqtuwīna) /uq.tu.wiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# اِقْتَوِينَ (iqtawīna) /iq.ta.wiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
